name: HardwareGuard BOM Studio
tagline: Deterministic PCBA BOM auditing, cross-board voltage conflict checks, and AI-assisted IPD release gating.
description: Catch costly PCBA manufacturing defects before SMT tape-out. HardwareGuard BOM Studio runs deterministic L0–L4 rules (value swaps, footprint mismatches like SMB vs SMA, capacitor derating margins < 1.25x, missing MPNs, EOL parts, and cross-board connector voltage conflicts) with conservative PASS/CONDITIONAL/REJECT IPD gating, persistent audit history, and zero-key AI Engineering Remediation & ECO Brief generation inside Anna AI OS.
